intro.fr: Chests 'n' Keys se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Chests 'n' Keys can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub not-aoyama/ChestsNKeys-Web, qui héberge l'APWorld de Chests 'n' Keys.
text.en: The GitHub repository not-aoyama/ChestsNKeys-Web, home of the Chests 'n' Keys APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.3.0 (préversion), seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v0.3.0 (pre-release) is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Chests 'n' Keys figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Chests 'n' Keys is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
